event.title: Katie Zacharia's Brief Debut as White House Press Secretary
event.canonical_title: Katie Zacharia's Brief Debut as White House Press Secretary
event.summary: Katie Zacharia has been appointed by Trump to succeed Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary. This change comes amid Trump's challenges with low approval ratings, partly due to the ongoing war with Iran.

timeline.title: Katie Zacharia's Brief Debut as White House Press Secretary
timeline.summary: Katie Zacharia, the new White House press secretary, conducted her first media briefing, which lasted less than 15 minutes. During the briefing, she called on only three reporters, all from conservative outlets, and spent a significant portion discussing President Trump's achievements.
key_facts: Katie Zacharia held her first briefing as White House press secretary.
The briefing lasted less than 15 minutes.
She called on three reporters from conservative outlets.
Half of the briefing was dedicated to discussing President Trump's achievements.
